a1_hello: Welcome to the pit wall. I'm your race engineer. Your two drivers drive the cars. You're the team principal. You make the calls.
a1_two: You run two cars. Tap your second driver on the pit wall to follow that car.
a1_each: Good. Each car takes its own calls. Ready to race?
a1_push: We're racing. Tell your driver to go faster. Tap push.
a1_tyres: Push is faster, but the tyres wear quicker. Keep an eye on tyre life.
a1_boost: Now the battery. Tap boost for twelve seconds of extra power.
a1_boost2: Boost empties the battery. It fills up again under braking.
a1_box: Time for a pit stop. Pick the soft tyres, then tap box.
a1_boxing: Copy. Your driver pits at the end of this lap.
a1_stop: Great stop. Fresh tyres, and back out on the fast lane.
a1_talk: You can say every call. Hold the mic, and say: push. Or: box, box.
a1_done: That's the job. Pace, battery, tyres and pit stops. Lesson one complete.
a2_hello: Your drivers race everyone, including each other. You decide when they fight.
a2_attack: Lights out. Your lead car has someone just ahead. Tap attack.
a2_attack2: Attack makes a pass more likely, but wears the tyres and risks contact. Within a second? Add boost.
a2_defend: Now your second car. Someone is close behind. Tap defend.
a2_defend2: Defend makes the car about half as easy to pass. Back to neutral when the fight is over.
a2_hold: Your two cars can fight each other and lose time. Tap hold positions.
a2_swap: When the car behind is faster, swap places lets it through.
a2_talk: All of these work on the radio. Hold the mic and say: attack. Or: hold positions.
a2_done: Attack, defend, hold and swap. Lesson two complete.
a3_hello: Every driver has a driver DNA. How late they brake, how hard they take corners, how eager they pass, and how kind they are to the tyres.
a3_two: Today, car one is an attacker. Car two is a tyre whisperer.
a3_watch: Watch car one. Braking late gains time, but now and then the wheels lock.
a3_wear: Now car two. Look at tyre life. Those tyres wear more slowly.
a3_circuit: Every circuit rewards a different driver. Long straights favour the brave. Tight tracks punish mistakes.
a3_tune: You tune the DNA between races. The proving ground tests a change first.
a3_done: Driver DNA, tuned to the circuit. Lesson three complete.
a4_hello: Races are won on strategy. Soft is fastest and wears quickest. Hard lasts longest.
a4_rule: In a dry race, every car must use two different dry tyres, or take a twenty second penalty.
a4_wait: A normal stop costs about ten seconds. The trick is when.
a4_sc: Safety car! A stop now costs about half. Box for mediums.
a4_boxing: Boxing under the safety car. The cheapest stop of the race.
a4_radar: Look at the weather. Rain is coming.
a4_done: Tyres, the safety car and the rain. Lesson four complete.
a5_hello: A full Grand Prix. I'll be on the radio, and the coach will help. Lights out when you're ready.
a5_race: Run your cars. Watch the tyres, and box when the window opens.
a5_done: Chequered flag. You ran a Grand Prix from the pit wall. Well done.
a_grad: That's all five lessons. You're an Academy graduate.
